title: Early-Acceptance Reduction on Residential Natural Gas Supply Renewals
content:
**Offer rule.** On a Residential Natural Gas Supply renewal within its term, the early-acceptance reduction depends on the calendar days from the acceptance date to the current contract end date: 0.0100 per therm when they are 30 or more, 0.0050 per therm when they are at least 15 but fewer than 30, and no reduction when they are fewer than 15. The reduction lowers the renewal rate by that amount per therm.

The record read is the current contract end date on the agreement; the acceptance date is the day the customer accepts.

| Calendar days from the acceptance date to the contract end date | Reduction per therm |
|---|---|
| 30 or more | 0.0100 |
| 15 to 29 | 0.0050 |
| 0 to 14 | none |

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical contract end date 30 September)

| Acceptance date | Days | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 31 August | 30 | 0.0100 |
| 1 September | 29 | 0.0050 |
| 15 September | 15 | 0.0050 |
| 16 September | 14 | none |
